summary: Join our credit risk management course tailored for banking professionals. Develop expertise in assessing and managing credit risks in today's market.
lede: Bank credit training develops structured methods for assessing borrower strength, repayment capacity and portfolio exposure. Designed for banking professionals who assess, approve, monitor or report credit, it covers financial statement analysis, the 5 Cs of Credit, credit scoring and PD/LGD/EAD interpretation. Participants also practise reviewing covenants and limits, monitoring concentration and early-warning signals, and explaining impairment and recovery decisions, including IFRS 9 concepts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for banking professionals who assess, approve, monitor, or report credit exposure and need structured methods for day-to-day lending decisions.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of banking products, basic financial statements, and lending terminology. Prior exposure to credit analysis, risk reporting, or loan administration is helpful but not mandatory. No coding is required, although familiarity with spreadsheets and banking dashboards will help you complete the practical exercises more effectively.
